story.inspiration: The play on words was too good not to...
story.whatItDoes: It's a social cheese rating and sharing website. Users can share their taste in cheeses and see what other people are trying as well.
story.challenges: Pinata is more confusing than initially assumed and the docs are missing a fair bit of context. That said, their docs context that you pass into cursor made the responses far better
story.accomplishments: Finishing the entire project by myself with the time and tech constraints. I impressed myself by what I accomplished
story.whatWeLearned: I learned to use Pinata mainly. Also deal with some cookies stuff when moving from localhost to a PWA hosted on a local network.
story.whatsNext: Cheddarboxd is going nation wide.. 10m DAU and 100k MRR by weeks end.

team.name: Joe Malatesta
team.contribution: I worked on the cheese and the box
